budget_items.topic: Articles D and E: stormwater consultant and school mini-split overage
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager confirmed the amounts for the stormwater consultant and the school mini-split overage.
budget_items.quote: town manager warren-dyment confirmed amounts: $42,900 for the stormwater consultant and $28,000 for the school mini-split overage.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Each use of a project estimator is estimated at about $7,000, and a $50,000 sum is proposed; funding source under review, with a preference for capital funds though free cash may be used.
budget_items.quote: each use of a project estimator is estimated to cost approximately $7,000, and that a sum of $50,000 is proposed

budget_items.topic: Article Q: temporary Special Assistant to the Assessor
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The temporary position would use the $27,500 appropriated at the May Annual Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: using the $27,500 appropriated at the may annual town meeting.

budget_items.topic: Article II: 41A senior property tax deferral income thresholds and interest rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Income eligibility thresholds would rise to circuit breaker levels; a pending question concerns whether the previously voted interest rate reduction from 8% to 4% needs annual reaffirmation.
budget_items.quote: $72,000 for single filers, $91,000 for head of household, and $109,000 for married filers

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board reviewed an accounts payable warrant with no vote recorded.
budget_items.quote: the select board reviewed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $1,613,540.86.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported that Unrestricted general government aid has fallen 25% in real terms since 2002.
budget_items.quote: unrestricted general government aid (ugga) has fallen 25% in real terms since 2002 despite strong state revenue growth.

budget_items.topic: State bill on family caregiver tax credits
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Announced in committee reports: a state bill would provide refundable tax credits to family caregivers.
budget_items.quote: a bill filed by a state representative would provide refundable tax credits of up to $1,500 to family caregivers.
